seoTitle: Merge PDF Files in Your Browser
metaDescription: Combine two to ten PDF files in the order you choose, up to 50 MB total.
intro: Combine two to ten PDF files in the order you choose, up to 50 MB total.
aboutTitle: How is page order decided when I merge PDFs?
about: The output follows the order in the file list, with pages from each document kept together. Move files into the correct order before merging.
exampleTitle: Combine an audit summary and appendix
example: Add the summary and appendix PDFs. Put the summary first, merge them and check the first page of the downloaded file.

faqs.question: Do I upload the PDFs to a server?
faqs.answer: The PDF files are processed in your browser. The total input size limit is 50 MB.
